narrative.overview: Kaunter is a bench the owner rearranges, not a report handed to them. A deep Tencent-blue ground carries a dotted canvas; flat 8px cards sit on the dots and snap to them. In view mode the dots recede (30% opacity) and the page reads as today at a glance. In edit mode the dots come up to full strength, cards go dashed-edged, and a glass tray of widget tiles slides in. The shift between the two is the whole interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-on-blue tonal layering: ground, canvas, card step lighter in that order.
One action colour (WorkBuddy green) and one alarm colour (Hornbill orange, overdue only).
Flat 8px cards with 1px low-alpha edges; glass and shadows only in dock, tray, popovers.
A dotted lattice that is the visible grid and the snap target.
Never colour alone: overdue carries an icon and the word.

rules.name: The Orange Is Overdue Rule
rules.body: Hornbill orange appears only on overdue items, and always with the alert icon and the word "overdue" (never colour alone). Nothing else, including warnings, may borrow it; use Sky for non-alarm states.

rules.name: The Green Means Act Rule
rules.body: Green marks what the owner can do or has done now. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Module Hue Rule
rules.body: Each widget module owns a gradient pair used only on its small header chip and its tray tile. These identify modules; they are not general palette colours.

rules.name: The Weight Is The Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Size steps are small (12.5 to 22px, plus the clock); distinction comes from 400 versus 700, never from a second family.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Amounts, times, dates, and chart values use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat Cards Rule
rules.body: A widget card at rest has no shadow and no blur. Glass and shadow are for the dock, tray, popovers, and transient drag states only.

dos: Do keep widget cards flat: card fill, 1px edge, 8px radius, no shadow at rest.
Do reserve Hornbill orange (#f2994a) for overdue and pair it with the alert icon and the word.
Do use WorkBuddy green only for action, selection, "now", and done states, with night-ink (#04163c) text on it.
Do use Atkinson Hyperlegible at 400 and 700 only; build hierarchy with weight.
Do keep layout on the integer cell lattice (x, y, w, h in cells, 3px inset) so snap and the dotted canvas stay the same grid.
Do give every new module a gradient pair for its header chip and tray tile, and a 3 by 2 or 3 by 3 minimum size.
Do keep glass, backdrop blur, and soft shadows to the dock, tray, popovers, and drag states.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion and give touch devices visible captions.
donts: Don't build a white or light KPI-card dashboard; the world is blue-on-blue.
Don't put shadows, blur, or gradients on widget cards.
Don't use orange for warnings, emphasis, or decoration; use Sky for non-alarm states.
Don't convey state with colour alone (overdue, done, placed all carry an icon or text).
Don't introduce a second typeface or a decorative display face.
Don't use ink-3 (#8aa3da) for text that must be read; it is for disabled and de-emphasised items.
